SELECT ?zone ?sensor ?ts WHERE {
  ?vav brick:feeds ?zone .
  ?vav brick:isTypeOf* brick:VAV .
  FILTER(?zone IN
   (<http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F3_Z01>,
    <http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F3_Z02>,
    <http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F3_Z03>,
    <http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F3_Z04>,
    <http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F3_Z05>))
  ?sensor brick:hasPropertyOf ?zone ;
          brick:isTypeOf* brick:AirTemperature .
  ?zone ref:hasTimeseriesId ?zts .
}
